title: Towards a Characterization of Microservice Architectures Generated by Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.20308v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for software design tasks, yet little is known about the structure and coherence of the architectures they produce. In particular, how LLMs behave in Architecture-to-Architecture transformations remains insufficiently understood. This study empirically characterizes how LLMs generate microservice architectures from natural language descriptions of modular monoliths, focusing on structural and descriptive properties rather than architectural correctness. We conduct controlled experiments on two modular monolith systems, comparing zero-shot and few-shot prompting strategies using GPT-based models from OpenAI and models from DeepSeek. Generated architectures are represented in a standardized CSV format and evaluated using normalized metrics capturing service granularity, inter-service communication patterns, communication density, service isolation, and responsibility descriptiveness. translated_title: 迈向大语言模型生成的微服务架构的特征刻画
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于软件设计任务，然而人们对其所生成架构的结构与一致性知之甚少。特别是，大语言模型在“架构到架构”转换中的行为仍缺乏充分的理解。本研究实证刻画了大语言模型如何从模块化单体系统的自然语言描述中生成微服务架构，重点关注结构和描述性属性，而非架构的正确性。我们在两个模块化单体系统上开展了受控实验，比较了基于OpenAI的GPT系列模型与DeepSeek模型，采用零样本和少样本两种提示策略。生成的架构以标准化的CSV格式表示，并使用归一化指标进行评估，这些指标涵盖服务粒度、服务间通信模式、通信密度、服务隔离以及职责描述性。（注：原摘要内容在此处不完整，以上为可翻译部分。）
tldr: 本研究通过受控实验实证刻画了大语言模型从模块化单体系统的自然语言描述生成微服务架构的结构与描述性特征，并比较了零样本与少样本提示策略在OpenAI和DeepSeek模型上的表现差异。
en_tdlr: This study empirically characterizes the structural and descriptive properties of microservice architectures generated by LLMs from natural language descriptions of modular monoliths, comparing zero-shot and few-shot prompting strategies across OpenAI and DeepSeek models.
